problems: Direction of federate vassal events: the schema reads vassal_start's counterpart as the vassal itself, but this batch (gothic-foederati, heruli 512-567, thracian-goths 473-474, alans-of-orleans 442-503) puts the suzerain as counterpart, as burgundian-kingdom does; heruli 491-494 (Heruli over the Lombards) follows the schema. The orchestrator should settle which reading the renderer uses.

thracian-goths now ends in 481 (was 484): Recitach's 481-484 is not drawn because no page gives him land or a relation with Rome; the ostrogoths dossier's union of the two Gothic groups should be dated by its own page.

Requests to neighbours (existing dossiers, not new ones): eastern-roman-empire (eu-05-a) contests with thracian-goths 471-473 and 474-481, the 473-474 federate pair, and the heruli Bassianae gain/vassal 512 and Singidunum grant 527; ostrogothic-kingdom and eastern-roman-empire should reconcile Syrmia east of Sirmium 510-536 with the Bassianae page (Bassianae to the Eastern Roman state after the 510 treaty; ostrogothic-kingdom_510/534 hold 5 of the 9 cells of heruli_512); kingdom-of-the-gepids (eu-06-e) holds the Bassianae district from 539 (heruli loss) and records its 536 and 539 gains as from the Eastern Roman Empire; ostrogoths (eu-06-d) holds no cell of Nitriansky kraj, so danubian-suebi's 468 loss and the Hunimund page's 'gained control of territory of the Sciri and Quadi' lack a gain; kingdom-of-soissons (eu-04) and salian-franks (eu-07) need matching vassal pairs for alans-of-orleans (476-486, 486-503); huns_454 holds Nitriansky in the founding year.

heruli ends with 7 confidence-1 events and alans-of-orleans with 5 (bridges, flagged in notes); the Wikipedia pages for Grepes, Sinduald, Sindual and Goar_(Alan_king) do not exist (url_not_found); the Goar page was opened and is silent on later rulers of Orleans.

Residual overlaps flagged in the dossiers: heruli_512/527 Bassianae district shares 5 of 9 cells with ostrogothic-kingdom_510/534 and 1 with gepids_510 (512-538); heruli_460 shares border cells with rugiland (1) and lombards (1-2); alans-of-orleans keeps 11 cells that visigothic-kingdom_469-490 holds.
